preRegisteredBefore: the first Actions run of scripts/quant/corporate-action-v3/audit-v3.mjs; no v3 result on real data exists. Thresholds, windows, label rules and the selection seed below are not changed after any result; a failed criterion is reported as NOT_READY.

predecessors.v4DataFix: PR #721/#722 (V4-D1/D2) - unchanged; their 83 cases and 74 adjusted-level securities are REGRESSION ONLY

scope: Canonical corporate-action data layer only. No calibration, no strategy performance, no change of source acceptance rules.
decisionRuleChangesVersusV2: FINRA OTC Daily List split events enter the evidence model like SEC effective events (anchor = ex-date, visible from publication); SEC vs FINRA ratio disagreement = CONFLICTING (HOLD)

NORMALIZE needs a second confirmation independent of the triggering statement for every ratio (second source, share volume in split direction, or SEC share count); v2 required it only below 3:1. Reason: v2 blocker B2 (aggregate normalize false share 0.25); derived from the two-confirmation principle, not from individual cases (the per-case v2 results are sealed and were not read)

event semantics of every overnight move >= 3:1 without provider event (discontinuity-semantics-1.0.0): mechanical split signature (event-day volume + persistent share-volume scaling) in either direction -> HOLD; extreme (>= 10:1) moves need a positive explanation (abnormal turnover, special distribution, bad tick, listing change), otherwise HOLD/QUARANTINE
RESUME_FROM: after a scale-type hold the series continues as a new segment with its own index base when the bars after it are valid on their own; no return across the break

validationOnly: SECOND_VENDOR_YAHOO_CHART (split events and split-adjusted closes; not point in time, no commercial licence, never a core input)
sources.labelSourceNotValidationSource: a label never uses the statement that triggered the decision: normalizations triggered by FINRA are not labelled by FINRA, share-count corroboration is not reused as label, course-only holds by definition carry no SEC/FINRA statement and are labelled by vendor, FINRA and share counts

pitOracle.method: TRUNCATION ORACLE: for each sampled as-of day t the engine view build(bars, {asOf: t}) is compared with build(bars <= t, evidence truncated outside the engine by its own publication timestamp, no asOf). Any difference in segments, holds, invalid ranges, normalizations or a total-return ratio (1e-9) is a violation. Timestamps: every SEC observation is compared with its EDGAR acceptance time (data.sec.gov/submissions, a different SEC system than the full-text search that supplies visibleAt); an observation treated as public before its acceptance day (US/Eastern) is a violation. observedAt of every hold, normalization, invalid range and RESUME_FROM must appear in the oracle view of that day (else OBSERVED_AT_TOO_EARLY, a violation); appearing already one session earlier is reported as late (conservative, not a violation). Revisions at +1/+5/+20 sessions and lag distributions are disclosed (review R2-07).
pitOracle.sampleOrder: segments with at least one hold, invalid range, normalization or RESUME_FROM, ascending sha256(seed + '|' + segmentId)
pitOracle.asOfPoints: per item: session before the event, event day, session before observedAt, observedAt, +1, +5, +20 sessions
pitOracle.independence: independent of the engine's as-of filtering (inputs physically truncated) and of the EFTS extraction (acceptance times from the submissions index). The SEC remains the authority for its own publication time; FINRA has a single timestamp (dailyListDatetime), so FINRA timing is checked by truncation only (disclosed limit). The signature/tr comparison re-runs the truncation outside the engine and is reported as a consistency check; the independent parts are the acceptance-time comparison (decision observations) and the observedAt-in-oracle-view check (review P3-06).

excluded: every segment with a V4 extreme security-month (2213, the 83 included) and every one of the 74 adjusted-level > 1e6 securities
every segment on which canonical-total-return-1.2.0 places SPLIT_SUSPECTED_UNDECLARED or PRICE_SPIKE_REVERTED (as protocol 2.0.0)
every member of the v2 control set (recomputed with the v2 seed and rules): seen data are not reused
blindedControlSet.blinding: categories and the independent event population are computed in stage select from raw price features, the second vendor, FINRA and SEC only, before any v3 contract is built; their sha256 is written to the public SELECT file before stage evaluate runs. The label module (labels.mjs) imports no engine of the core (test B1).

categories.VOLATILE: top decile of the daily raw log-return standard deviation (no provider event days), median raw close >= 1
categories.CONFIRMED_FORWARD_SPLIT: an independent forward split >= 1.5 inside the segment: second vendor (identity CONFIRMED), FINRA, or an SEC effective statement
categories.CONFIRMED_REVERSE_SPLIT: an independent reverse split <= 1/1.5: second vendor, FINRA, SEC effective statement, or an SEC share-count drop <= 1/3 within 200 days
categories.DOWNWARD_JUMP: at least one overnight raw close ratio <= 1/3 without provider event
categories.SYMBOL_CHANGE: issuer CIK continues under another ticker within 30 days after the segment ends, or a FINRA symbol change / exchange-to-OTC change in the window
categories.MERGER: delisted, delisting class ACQUISITION or MERGER_FORM

labels.vendorIdentity: daily raw returns of vendor and provider agree within 1 % on >= 90 % of >= 60 common consecutive days (days > 25 % excluded): CONFIRMED; < 50 %: MISMATCH; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE / INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP. Only CONFIRMED vendor data label anything.
labels.vendorMove: vendor raw move on the day (split-adjusted close x later vendor split ratios): SAME_MOVE within 10 % of the provider move; NO_MOVE below half of it in log terms; OTHER_MOVE otherwise
labels.event: vendor split within 5 days that explains the move, FINRA split within 10 days that explains it, or SEC shares CONFIRMS (protocol 2.0.0 definition)
labels.badData: vendor NO_MOVE and no vendor split within 5 days
labels.genuine: vendor SAME_MOVE, no vendor split within 15 days, no FINRA split within 10 days, SEC shares not CONFIRMS
labels.HOLD: TRUE_POSITIVE = event or badData; FALSE_POSITIVE = genuine; else UNLABELED
labels.NORMALIZE: TRUE_POSITIVE = vendor split of the same ratio (1 %) within 5 days, FINRA same ratio (not if FINRA triggered), SEC shares CONFIRMS (not if the share count was the corroboration); FALSE_POSITIVE = vendor split of another ratio (> 5 %), vendor SAME_MOVE without split within 15 days, SEC shares NO_SPLIT (same caveat); else UNLABELED
labels.INVALID_RANGE_AND_SEMANTIC_DATA_HOLD: TRUE_POSITIVE = badData or event; FALSE_POSITIVE = genuine; else UNLABELED
labels.SEMANTIC_TERMINAL: TRUE_POSITIVE = FINRA listing event within 5 days; FALSE_POSITIVE = genuine; else UNLABELED
labels.courseOnlyHold: a hold whose evidence is the price alone: evidence class PRICE_DISCONTINUITY_NO_CA_EVIDENCE, or a semantic quarantine/terminal without any source statement
labels.falseNegativePopulation: independent events inside the segment: vendor splits (identity CONFIRMED, |ln q| >= ln 1.5), FINRA splits (not cancelled), SEC share-count drops <= 1/3 within 200 days (deduplicated). Excluded from the rate: PROVIDER_DECLARED (provider factor of the same ratio within the window) and NOT_IN_PRICE (no day in the window that the ratio explains). FALSE_NEGATIVE = the explained day is a valid canonical return (same segment) with |ln g| >= |ln q| / 2. Course-only events: no SEC statement within 60 days and no FINRA split within 10 days. Direction: q < 1 reverse (upward jump), q > 1 forward (downward jump). OUTSIDE_VALID (after an earlier non-resumable break) is not evaluable. Gates use engine-independent events (second vendor) only; FINRA and share-count events are engine inputs and reported separately.
labels.extremeMoveClass: CONFIRMED_EVENT = event; BAD_DATA = badData; LEGITIMATE_MOVE = genuine; else UNRESOLVED
labels.labelSourceExclusion: every label blanks the channels (FINRA, SEC share count) that appear in the sources of the decision it scores; vendor first for NORMALIZE

acceptance.knownD2ValidRangeDefects: 0, and the 11 known D2 defects must be reproduced exactly
acceptance.secondSourceIntegrated: FINRA collection complete and >= 1 EFFECTIVE FINRA split event with a parsed ratio joined to the universe
acceptance.intervals: Wilson 95 % reported with every rate; acceptance on the point estimate
acceptance.noTuning: no threshold, window, tolerance, label rule or seed in this file or in the v3 engines is changed after the first run result; a failed criterion is NOT_READY

readinessRule: READY_FOR_PREREGISTERED_CALIBRATION only if every acceptance criterion passes AND the independent review leaves no HIGH/CRITICAL finding open; otherwise NOT_READY. The 83/74 regression and the D2 regression are reported; D2 also gates via knownD2ValidRangeDefects.

preRunReview.round: P3 (independent review agent, separate context, read-only, before any run)
changesBeforeAnyResult: P3-01: split signature no longer uses the (vacuous) conventional-ratio check; it needs event-day mechanical volume AND persistent share-volume scaling over the next 10 sessions (observedAt after that window). GENUINE_MOVE = event-day share volume >= 3x median. Crash tests added.
P3-02/P3-03: labels blank every channel that took part in the decision (FINRA, SEC share count); for NORMALIZE the vendor is read first so independent FP evidence is never overridden
P3-04: RESUME_FROM observedAt = first as-of view containing the segment (never before the hold that created the break)
P3-05: blinded set keeps segments flagged by the 1.2.0 core (only 83/74 and v2 members excluded); reported as a stratum
P3-06: acceptance-time check restricted to SEC observations behind decisions; the truncation comparison is reported as an engine consistency check; skipped observedAt items counted
P3-07: OUTSIDE_VALID not evaluable; FN gates use engine-independent (second-vendor) events only; FINRA/share-count events reported separately
P3-08: FINRA corrections (DC/DD) supersede the announcement even when they move the ex-date

P3-09: gates tightened: FINRA effective events with a parsed ratio; D2 must reproduce 11; >= 30 labelable segments per category; severe = extreme moves left in valid returns that independent evidence calls an event/bad data (0) or cannot explain (<= 10 %); blinded per-intervention false share gate
P3-10: resumed bars reported by the label of the break
P3-11: the authoring session decides readiness from the public counts only; the session envelope is not decrypted before the verdict is written
P3-12: one prepare job builds ciks.json and the vendor ticker windows for all collection jobs; SOURCES_DISAGREE observedAt waits for both sources
